title: SF87 (2023-2024 Regular): Constitutional amendment protecting the right of the people to keep and bear arms

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-06; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/87/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced 2023-01-06. Section 2 sends the amendment to voters at the 2024 general election.

operative_text: Section 1 (proposed Minn. Const. art. I, sec. 18): A well regulated militia, being necessary to the security of a free state, the right of the people to keep and bear arms, shall not be infringed.
